leaks.answer: The passages mention a few charges for a standard Bajaj Finance personal loan, as general guidance. First, penal charges may apply if you break a key condition of your loan agreement. These are a flat penalty, not added to your interest rate, and they do not compound. Second, for a Term Loan, part-prepayment and foreclosure charges apply if you pay off early, and there is a lock-in period before you can do so. For the full and current list of all fees and charges, Bajaj Finance's pages advise checking their fees and charges page or your own loan agreement directly.
